thought: VCP leader breakout. Same 321 upper-half fills and original exits. One added sell: close crosses below MA10, next market open.
hypothesis: The production MA20 trend exit is slow for a 2-20 day swing. Crossing below MA10 should cut more give-back without scanning MA length.

baseline.selection: breakout close in the upper half of the signal-day range
baseline.exits: original plan stop / MA20 / profit lock / stop-loss

change.definition: MA10 is the mean of the last 10 market-session closes including today; all 10 bars must exist. Fire when previous close >= previous MA10 and today's close < today's MA10. Exit at the next market open if that session is strictly before the original exit. A stock hole on a market session, incomplete MA10, nonpositive volume, or one-price limit-down does not roll. Training does not read bars after 2022-12-31.

metric.primary: independent win_rate, profit_factor, avg_pnl vs the same 321 original-exit pnls
metric.validation_if_keep: same overlay on 2023-2026 completed upper-half fills, labeled exposure

pass_fail.pass: training avg_pnl not below the 321-trade upper-half original-exit baseline and remains positive
pass_fail.fail: Drop this sell. Baseline stays 321 original-exit upper-half. Next VCP edit still one mechanism.
